tara-people-ops: Quick update — the annual Data Handling micro-certification is past 60% completion and were escalating the remaining list to managers tomorrow. Please prioritize completion by Friday COB. Short 10m exec ask: Evan, could you post a quick note to encourage folks?

mika-eng: Noted. Any change to the quiz/content?

tara-people-ops: No content changes. We added a 5-question scenario appendix last sprint; its optional but recommended. It only takes ~7 minutes.

leo-security: To confirm: completion is required for any engineer with access to customer data or infra. We'll need completion records exported for the SOC2 auditor.

julia-hr: Managers will receive a CSV of non-completers at 9am tomorrow. Please review with your team and escalate exceptions to me.

mika-eng: Can we get a grace-period exception for people on parental leave?

julia-hr: Yes — use the form linked in the course. Well grant a 30-day exception and mark it in the export.

evan-cto: Quick note from me: team leads, please ask folks to do this today if possible. It's short but essential for our attestation. Ill drop a reminder in #general at 2pm.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Data Handling micro-cert completion due in 72 hours. Owners and managers have been notified.

mika-eng: Uploading my completion receipt now. Thanks for the heads up.

tara-people-ops: Appreciate it. If you run into SSO issues, DM @julia-hr and @leo-security. We'll keep the thread open until the manager exports are posted.
